notes.title: Demo-version update
notes.notes: Demo-version is actualized to v.1.0 now

notes.title: RELEASE!
Going to release!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that the development of current version of the game is nearing completion!
A lot has been done since coming to early access on Steam, added new screens and functionality, some screens were redesigned. We want to thank community for feedback, bug reports and suggestions for improving the game - this is valuable for us. Thanks!

And now announcement of the Open Wheel Manager release date:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901253/7929f7ae5972a1031289b3de63dc5507b6a9f543.png[/img]

In v. 1.0 you will appreciate modified user interface and function of randomly drivers generation on new game start as well. Follow our updates and you will not miss anything!

notes.title: Update delayed
notes.notes:
We need another 5-7 days to teach bots how to make pit stops depending on weather changes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34901253/6012de5c1a7f56eefb293201e10f463112e99958.png[/img]

notes.title: Update to v.0.8.9
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34901253/034f8bf323ab0f67a795f8baf949bc785df29721.jpg[/img]

[list][*] [b]Added new system of negotiations with drivers, engine suppliers and key staff. Negotiations have progress-bar now and their speed depends on negotiating staff (from commercial facility) and interest marker.[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34901253/aba7713ac669be6aafa6d1ee6ca6295b1010122e.jpg[/img]

Up to the end of June there will be added negotiations with sponsors on negotiations section (v.0.9.0)
Besides, on this week editor will be released , where you can create your own mod by editing teams, drivers, engines and staff.

On this moment Patch 0.8.9 is the most global change in the game since release in early access. But the final July update dedicated to the race screen  will be even more significant.

The demo-version update to v.0.8.9 will be later.

notes.title: Version 0.8.7. What's new?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34901253/c769299e4f1e32d0f9348d07b4248a3f2e1b0ca6.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Hotkeys added.
[i]In "office": Space is Continue button; 
In race-screen: Space is Pause, 1,2,3 buttons - race speed switching[/i]
[*] Key staff can finish the career now
[*] 3 new young drivers are generated in every off- season.
[*] The new key staff will generated only if current one is not enough for all teams.
[*] Pay drivers added now. The chance to be a "pay driver"  for new young drivers is 30%, for current drivers is 10% on start of new game (only for non-top drivers).
[*] A new hidden parameter for drivers is talent. The talent is influence on skill improvement speed. If there no talent parameter in the game database in the drivers table, it will generated automatically
[/list]

Welcome feedback!

[list]
[*] Fixed bug in AI-teams race strategy (they made one more pit-stop than needed)
[*] The navigation over interface using left and right arrows on keyboard is added
